prose: Stratechery's Ben Thompson interviews Palantir CTO Shyam Sankar - twenty years at the company - on diffusing intelligence rather than just producing it, AI safety, what Palantir has learned deploying AI, the forward-deployed engineer model, Anthropic's battle with the US government, and what he calls the industry's religious war over AI.
highlights: Sankar on diffusing intelligence, safety and Palantir's AI lessons
Covers Anthropic vs. the US government and tech's 'religious war' over AI
